binding.description: The component is recorded unverified because no live proxy session proves its signed pin.

immediate: Route the server through cxbom proxy with a signed lock
shortTerm: Pass the proxySessionId from the listing into the assembly
strategic: Fail the pipeline gate on unverified tool definitions

blocked.description: The proxy blocked tool fetch/fetch (verdict changed) and it never reached the context.

immediate: None required. The proxy removed the definition before the model saw it
shortTerm: Review the change with cxbom approve if it is expected
strategic: Keep the server in enforce mode

change.description: The proxy saw a definition whose hash differs from the signed pin, and it was assembled.

immediate: Stop the session and review the changed definition
shortTerm: Run the proxy in enforce mode so changed definitions are blocked
strategic: Re-approve only after reviewing the new definition text

missing-credentials.description: No scanner supplied containsCredentials, containsSecretsOrKeys. The record marks them notCollected.

immediate: Attach a scanner callback to the assembly
shortTerm: Record scanner name, version and time for every component
strategic: Gate on missing-control findings with --fail-on any-strict

missing-injection.description: No scanner supplied injectionRiskRating, sanitization.scanner, sanitization.scannerVersion, sanitization.scannedAt. The record marks them notCollected.

immediate: Attach a scanner callback to the assembly
shortTerm: Record scanner name, version and time for every component
strategic: Gate on missing-control findings with --fail-on any-strict

missing-pii.description: No scanner supplied containsPII. The record marks them notCollected.

immediate: Attach a scanner callback to the assembly
shortTerm: Record scanner name, version and time for every component
strategic: Gate on missing-control findings with --fail-on any-strict

role-marker.description: Component text contains tokenizer control tokens that the model reads as structure.

immediate: Remove or escape the control tokens before assembly
shortTerm: Reject content carrying chat markers at ingestion
strategic: Tokenize untrusted content with special-token splitting disabled

special.description: Component text contains tokenizer control tokens that the model reads as structure.

immediate: Remove or escape the control tokens before assembly
shortTerm: Reject content carrying chat markers at ingestion
strategic: Tokenize untrusted content with special-token splitting disabled

immediate: Apply a registered trust-downgrade label to the external tool definition
shortTerm: Keep the server pinned and bound to a live proxy session
strategic: Assemble external tool definitions outside the operator's tool-schema block

special-spelled.description: Component text spells tokenizer control tokens that the component's ids do not carry. Re-tokenizing the text would turn them into structure.

immediate: Remove or escape the control tokens before assembly
shortTerm: Reject content carrying chat markers at ingestion
strategic: Tokenize untrusted content with special-token splitting disabled

special-mixed.description: Component text contains tokenizer control tokens. The model reads <tool_call> as structure. The text only spells <think>, which the component's ids do not carry. Re-tokenizing the text would turn those into structure.

immediate: Remove or escape the control tokens before assembly
shortTerm: Reject content carrying chat markers at ingestion
strategic: Tokenize untrusted content with special-token splitting disabled
